title: still present since round 3: entering demo clobbers a live landlord session; exit downgrades auth to NotAsked
evidence:
client.gleam enter_demo: `auth: Success(landlord),
          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",
          demo_mode: True,
          demo_store: Some(store),` (unconditional overwrite). model.gleam clear_demo_state: `demo_mode: False,
    demo_store: None,
    auth: NotAsked,` — no session re-check is dispatched on the public-route exit path (client.gleam:496).
detail: A logged-in landlord who opens /demo loses SPA session state; exiting to /signup leaves auth NotAsked with no check_session fired, so they appear logged out until a full reload despite an intact session cookie.
recommended_fix: Preserve pre-demo auth and restore it on exit, or dispatch auth_api.check_session(ApiReturnedSession) on the public-route exit arm.

title: still present since round 3: demo exit from a dirty edit page clears demo state before the unsaved-changes guard fires
evidence:
Exit path (496): `handle_browser_change(model |> model.clear_demo_state, uri, route)`. Guard inside handle_browser_change (5390-5397): `case model.vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes {
            True -> #(
              Model(
                ..updated_model,
                route: model.route,
                show_unsaved_changes_prompt: True,`. clear_demo_state (model.gleam:747-768) does not reset vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes.
detail: On a dirty demo edit page, clicking the banner CTA (/signup) clears demo state first, then the guard prompts and URL-replaces back to /vacancies/<fixture-id>/edit against an already-exited demo (demo_mode False, demo_store None).
recommended_fix: Run the dirty-edit guard before clear_demo_state, or suppress the prompt when the destination is a public route exiting the demo.

title: still present since round 3: deep-link demo boots fire only demo_entry; per-surface analytics undercount the primary entry path
evidence:
demo_entry_effects VacancyDetail arm: `routes.VacancyDetail(id) | routes.VacancyHandoff(id) -> [
      demo_api.get_detail(store, id, ApiReturnedVacancyDetail),
      demo_api.fetch_leaderboard(store, id, ApiReturnedLeaderboard),
    ]` — no capture_event in any arm; contrast handle_browser_change's in-demo arm: `demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_vacancy_open)`.
detail: A fresh boot into /vacancies/v-maples counts demo_entry but not demo_vacancy_open, while the identical in-session navigation counts both; engagement metrics undercount shared-URL entries.
recommended_fix: Fire the matching surface event in demo_entry_effects' route arms (vacancy, application, archived, comparison).

title: still present since round 3: comparison deep link passes persisted real localStorage ids into the demo store
evidence:
`routes.Comparison(vid) -> [
      demo_api.fetch_comparison(
        store,
        vid,
        load_comparison_ids(),
        ApiReturnedComparisonDetails,
      ),
    ]` — load_comparison_ids() reads the real product's localStorage key unconditionally.
detail: A real landlord's persisted comparison ids (real UUIDs) are looked up in the demo store on boot; the demo comparison deep link lands empty, and the boot path disagrees with the navigation path.
recommended_fix: Prefer fixture comparison ids in demo (or gate on demo-shaped v- ids) and mirror the navigation path's empty-ids guard.

title: still present since round 3: failed demo seed desyncs model.route from the browser URL
evidence:
`Error(_) -> #(
      Model(..model, route: routes.Landing, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None),
      effect.none(),
    )`
detail: On seed failure the address bar stays /demo (or the demo deep link) while the Landing page renders; no navigation effect, no feedback.
recommended_fix: Return modem.replace("/", None, None) alongside the Landing route so the rendered page matches the URL.

title: still present since round 3: edit deep-link boot renders the empty editable form for the first frame (enter_demo never sets vacancy_edit_loading)
detail: The get_for_edit response lands and populates the form, but the first frame renders the empty editable form instead of the loading skeleton on a /vacancies/v-*/edit boot.
recommended_fix: Set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo when the boot route is VacancyEdit.

title: still present since round 3: demo navigation writes comparison ids to the real product's localStorage
detail: Demo interactions persist into the real product's localStorage keys; a demo -> signup path hydrates real screens with demo comparison state.
recommended_fix: Skip save_comparison_ids while model.demo_mode (or namespace demo storage keys).

title: still present since round 3: latent policy re-acceptance modal could surface in demo and fire a real accept_policy POST
evidence:
`UserAcceptedPolicy ->
      case model.policy_reaccept_loading {
        True -> #(model, effect.none())
        False -> #(
          Model(..model, policy_reaccept_loading: True),
          auth_api.accept_policy(` — no demo_mode guard, and grep of client/src/demo/demo_update.gleam finds no UserAcceptedPolicy arm (update/2 routes all demo messages through demo_update.handle first, which passes it through).
detail: Latent only: the fixture's accepted_policy_version is pinned so the modal never surfaces today, but a server policy bump would surface it in demo and the accept fires a real POST.
recommended_fix: Intercept UserAcceptedPolicy in demo_update.handle as a no-op (or guard the update_inner arm on demo_mode).

title: still present since round 3: download_timeout duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam with divergent signatures
detail: The store_of half of the r3 duplication note is fixed (client.gleam:5919 delegates to demo_update.store_of), but download_timeout still exists twice with different arities; the two can drift independently.
recommended_fix: Lift download_timeout into a shared demo helper (or export demo_update's) so one implementation serves both dispatch layers.
